services.desc: Capitol Boat Club has carefully selected a variety of quality boats for our fleet. We pride ourselves on providing the newest, cleanest, and best-maintained rental boats Madison has to offer. Rentals and charters are open to the public - no membership required. Find and book your boat online. Simply select your date and capacity needs, then review available time slots and prices for each boat. Pick what works best for you! Choose from our fleet of late model pontoon and deck boats with powerful 90 or 115hp motors.
